author: waredjeb
body:
### PR Description
@bfonta noticed we were missing PFMuons at HLT (Phase-2). After investigation, we noticed an inconsistency between Muons inner tracks (`hltPhase2L3Muons` pointing to `hltPhase2L3MuonMerged`) and PFTracks (built from 'hltGeneralTracks'). 
This inconsistency makes the `PFMuonAlgo::muAssocToTrack` [1] always fail as is comparing `edm::Ref` of 2 separate collections.
This PR adds a new PF collection built repointing muons inner track links to `hltGeneralTracks`, following Run-3 style.

Uses:
- `hltPhase2L3MuonLinks`  to extract Muon links [2]
- `hltPhase2MuonLinksForPF` (`MuonLinksProducerForHLT`) to match muon track inner links to `hltGeneralTracks` [3]
- - `hltPhase2MuonsForPF` (`MuonIdProducer`): create muon collection using `hltGeneralTracks` as track collection [4]

### Validation
Validated on `/RelValZMM_14/CMSSW_20_0_0_pre1-150X_mcRun4_realistic_v1_STD_RegeneratedGS_D121_noPU-v1/GEN-SIM-DIGI-RAW`

Plots: https://wredjeb.web.cern.ch/PFMuonsFix/


### Reference
[1] [cms-sw/cmssw/RecoParticleFlow/PFProducer/src/PFMuonAlgo.cc](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/12b8ddb64e4957b84863295f6327e72d47ff0770/RecoParticleFlow/PFProducer/src/PFMuonAlgo.cc#L487)

Run-3 HLT menu reference: https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/master/HLTrigger/Configuration/python/HLT_GRun_cff.py

[2] In Run3 
```
fragment.hltL3MuonsIterL3Links = cms.EDProducer( "MuonLinksProducer",
    inputCollection = cms.InputTag( "hltIterL3Muons" )
)
```

[3] In Run-3

```
fragment.hltMuonLinks = cms.EDProducer( "MuonLinksProducerForHLT",
    LinkCollection = cms.InputTag( "hltL3MuonsIterL3Links" ),
    InclusiveTrackerTrackCollection = cms.InputTag( "hltPFMuonMerging" ),
    ptMin = cms.double( 2.5 ),
    pMin = cms.double( 2.5 ),
    shareHitFraction = cms.double( 0.8 )
)
```

[4] In Run-3 
```
fragment.hltMuons = cms.EDProducer( "MuonIdProducer",
    MuonCaloCompatibility = cms.PSet( 
      delta_eta = cms.double( 0.02 ),
      delta_phi = cms.double( 0.02 ),
      allSiPMHO = cms.bool( False ),
      MuonTemplateFileName = cms.FileInPath( "RecoMuon/MuonIdentification/data/MuID_templates_muons_lowPt_3_1_norm.root" ),
      PionTemplateFileName = cms.FileInPath( "RecoMuon/MuonIdentification/data/MuID_templates_pions_lowPt_3_1_norm.root" )
    ),
...
    inputCollectionLabels = cms.VInputTag( 'hltPFMuonMerging','hltMuonLinks','hltL2Muons' ),
```
title: Fix HLT PFMuons
